digo_source: Mgombato ('futsure, futswe, tsalakushe ... Asystasia gangetica'); Pakia ('Futswe')

teaser.en: This creeping weed with pale bell-shaped flowers has three Digo names, and its leaves go into the cooking pot.
teaser.sw: Gugu hili linalotambaa, lenye maua mepesi ya umbo la kengele, lina majina matatu ya Kidigo, na majani yake huingia chunguni.

summary.en: *Futswe*, also called *futsure* or *tsalakushe*, is the Chinese violet, a spreading herb of shady farm edges. Its leaves are eaten as a vegetable.
summary.sw: *Futswe*, pia huitwa *futsure* au *tsalakushe*, ni kichwamangwo, mmea unaoenea katika pembezoni mwa mashamba zenye kivuli. Majani yake huliwa kama mboga.

about.en: *Futswe* is a spreading, scrambling herb that roots along its stems and forms a loose mat. The leaves are oval and soft, in opposite pairs. The flowers are pale and bell-shaped, opening along one side of a short spike.
about.sw: *Futswe* ni mmea unaoenea na kutambaa, ambao hutoa mizizi kwenye mashina yake na kutengeneza zulia lililolegea. Majani yake ni ya umbo la yai na laini, yakiwa jozi zinazotazamana. Maua yake ni ya rangi nyepesi na ya umbo la kengele, yakichanua upande mmoja wa kishada kifupi.

where.en: It grows on shady farm edges and in the bush, where it can scramble over other low plants.
where.sw: Huota kwenye pembezoni mwa mashamba zenye kivuli na vichakani, ambapo unaweza kutambaa juu ya mimea mingine mifupi.

uses.en: The leaves are eaten as a vegetable.

names.en: Digo has three names for this plant: *futswe*, *futsure* and *tsalakushe*. Pakia records *futswe*. Swahili calls it *kichwamangwo*. In English it is Chinese violet or creeping foxglove.
names.sw: Kidigo kina majina matatu ya mmea huu: *futswe*, *futsure* na *tsalakushe*. Pakia inarekodi *futswe*. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *kichwamangwo*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *Chinese violet* au *creeping foxglove*.

reason.en: Another wild leaf vegetable from the farm
reason.sw: Mboga nyingine ya majani ya porini kutoka shambani

reason.en: Another wild leaf vegetable from fallows
reason.sw: Mboga nyingine ya majani ya porini kutoka mashamba yaliyoachwa yapumzike
